snippet.title: (Mario) The Music Box in-game Intro (Warning: Flashing Lights)
snippet.description:
Movie/Game: Team Ari
Music: Ayane
Breakcore Remix: YZYX https://yzyx.bandcamp.com/track/higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni-ps2-op-nageki-no-mori-breakcore-remix

Credits:
Overlays: CrizzLy- Edit'  http://www.youtube.com/xXPsyKiLL102
Blood Brushes: Screamotizer http://screamotizer.deviantart.com/
Rain overlay: Daniel Norris https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCa9IB-ip3zUGQakXtg6_R3w
Clock Hands: http://www.clker.com/clipart-52239.html
Clock: http://www.dhtmlgoodies.com/tutorials/canvas-clock/images/Clock_Face_2_by_AGF81.png
Title Font: http://www.fontspace.com/blambot/youmurderer-bb

Tools:
Paint Tool Sai
Photoshop CS6
Sony Vegas Pro 12

The in-game intro for (Mario) The Music Box. 2nd try with Sony Vegas, I am slowly learning a bit more of how it works. But I'm still not good enough, this was made within 1 day of work(excluding free time).
MTMB release will be very soon!~
Temporary Website and demo download: http://mariothemusicbox.webs.com/

You can view my art at my DeviantArt.
http://marios-friend9.deviantart.com/
